spec2def(modemui.dll modemui.spec)

# modemui.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/modemui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(modemui_shims OBJECT modemui.c)
target_link_libraries(modemui_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(modemui_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(modemui modemui-cargo modemui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS modemui_shims psdk)
